dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A run-data type for dimensions m and r and a model. Its supplied constructor packages positive m and r, a vector b, Householder vectors, local perturbation matrices, computed vectors, output indices, reflector assumptions, exact perturbed-product semantics, and agreement with model outputs at unit roundoff.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target fixes such a run and uses its b, Householder vectors, perturbations, and computed result; all run invariants are implicit hypotheses.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.b, a real vector indexed by Fin m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the vector multiplied by every matrix in both exact decomposition identities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.computed, a function assigning an m-vector to each real parameter u and outcome omega.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the left-hand side of both global decomposition identities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.householderVector, assigning an m-vector to every natural index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines all reflector matrices P_j and their products Q_k.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.localPerturbation, assigning an m by m real matrix to each parameter u, natural step, and outcome.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These matrices are the perturbations Delta_j(u,omega) used in all first-order terms and products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: A local-certificate type for a run, c5, and lambda. Its constructor packages a measurable probability-one event, an exact characterization by perturbation operator bounds at unit roundoff, and entrywise O(u) behavior of each relevant perturbation near zero on that event.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target is universal over such a certificate and requires the two remainder estimates only on its event.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection hlocal.localEvent, a subset of Omega.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the event on which both remainder functions must be entrywise O(u^2).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: A stochastic floating-point model type. Its constructor packages a probability measure, operation data, exact and computed values, bounded measurable integrable mean-zero errors, a unit roundoff in [0,1), and a mean-independence condition relative to prior errors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem quantifies over models satisfying this encoded structure; their probability measure and unit roundoff determine the run and local-event assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The vector Q_r b, where Q_r is the product of the first r reflector matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the common unperturbed baseline in both decomposition identities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: For j<r, the transformed perturbation Q_{j+1}^T Delta_j(u,omega) Q_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The last conjunct equates this definition to its defining expression, so that conjunct is definitionally tautological.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The matrix sum from j=0 to r-1 of Q_{j+1}^T Delta_j(u,omega) Q_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first-order matrix inside the factored decomposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The recursively accumulated unfactored first-order perturbation A_r, with A_0=0 and A_{k+1}=P_k A_k+Delta_k Q_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first-order matrix inside the unfactored decomposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The transpose Q_r^T of the reflector product Q_r.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target transposes it again, producing (Q_r^T)^T=Q_r in the factored identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The left-product recursion Q_0=I and Q_{k+1}=P_k Q_k; hence Q_k=P_{k-1}...P_0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all unperturbed prefix products occurring in the baseline, first-order terms, and final equality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given vectors v_j, it returns P_j=I-v_j v_j^T.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns the run's Householder vectors into the reflector matrices used throughout the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary finite matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)_i=sum_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every application of an m by m matrix to b and defines the Euclidean operator bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a matrix-valued function R(u), every entry R_ij(u) is O(u^2) as u tends to zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is exactly the required second-order condition on both existential remainders for each outcome in the local event.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run constructor requires m>0 and r>0; data b, v_j, Delta_j, computed, and output indices; sum_i v_j(i)^2=2 and P_j^2=I for j<r; computed(u,omega)=T_r(u,omega)b for the perturbed product; and agreement with selected model computations at unit roundoff.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These constructor premises are inherited assumptions behind every quantified run and justify interpreting computed as the exact perturbed reflector product.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The local-certificate constructor takes a measurable event E such that omega is in E exactly when every Delta_j at unit roundoff has induced Euclidean bound c5 times the stated exponential factor, requires each Delta_j(u,omega) to be entrywise O(u) on E, and requires the model probability of E to equal one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the probability-one event and first-order local perturbation behavior from which the remainder estimates are asserted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model constructor packages a measure mu with mu(Omega)=1, an operation count, exact/computed/error functions satisfying computed=exact*(1+error), unit roundoff 0<=u0<1, error bounds |error|<=u0, measurability, integrability, zero means, and the prior-error factorization property.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the quantified models and supplies the probability and unit-roundoff data used by the run and local certificate, although the conclusion contains no new probabilistic estimate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices P_j and perturbations Delta_j, it defines A_0=0 and A_{k+1}=P_k A_k+Delta_k Q_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At k=r this is the unfactored first-order term LocalDef012.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a vector v, it is the matrix with entries delta_ij-v_i v_j, namely I-vv^T.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines each reflector P_j from the corresponding Householder vector.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: A natural-number case eliminator selecting the supplied zero value at 0 and the supplied successor value at k+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the base and successor branches of the product recursion LocalDef014.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every matrix entry i,j, A_ij(u) is asymptotically O(scale(u)) along the neighborhood filter of 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With scale u it states first-order perturbations; with scale u^2 it states second-order remainders.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines Q_{j+1}^T Delta_j(u,omega) Q_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is each summand of the factored first-order term and the value expanded in the target's last conjunct.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: It sums LocalDef025 over the natural indices j in {0,...,k-1}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At k=r it gives the factored first-order sum S_r.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model projection error, indexed by operation and outcome.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It participates in the encoded stochastic assumptions but does not occur explicitly in the final matrix identities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model's natural-number operation count.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the finite index type for model operations and the codomain of the run's output-index map.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model's measure on Omega.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives probability one to the local event through the certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model's real unit roundoff u0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is where model computations agree with the run and where the local event's operator bounds are evaluated.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real Kronecker delta: 1 when its two indices are equal and 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the identity-matrix entries in P_j=I-v_jv_j^T.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: The scalar rho_k(lambda,u)=exp(((lambda*sqrt(k))*u+k*u^2)/(1-u))-1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With k=m and u equal to unit roundoff, c5*rho_m(lambda,u) is the local-event operator-bound constant.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each operation k and each function g of the preceding errors, whenever both relevant functions are integrable, the integral of g(previous errors)*error_k factors as the product of their integrals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the stochastic models being quantified over; it is not itself a conclusion about the remainder matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: The perturbed product recursion T_0=I and T_{k+1}=(P_k+Delta_k(u,omega))T_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run constructor identifies run.computed(u,omega) with T_r(u,omega)b.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: A parameterized natural-number case eliminator selecting a zero branch at 0 and a successor branch at k+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the recurrences for LocalDef021 and LocalDef034 without adding a mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a matrix A and scalar L, it states that every vector x satisfies ||Ax||_2<=L||x||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the induced Euclidean-norm perturbation bound characterizing membership in the local event.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: For operation k, outcome omega, and i<k, it returns the earlier error error_i(omega), forming the vector of errors before k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the prior-error vector used in the model's factorization condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean norm ||x||_2=sqrt(sum_i x_i^2) of a finite real vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the norm used in the local perturbation operator bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: If k<steps and i<k, then i<steps.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It validates reindexing a prior error as an operation index and contributes no additional assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual strict order on natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite additive sum of a function over a finite set.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe

binders: A type Omega equipped with a measurable-space structure.
Natural numbers m and r, a model M of type LocalDef008 Omega, and a run of type LocalDef001 Omega m r M.
A natural number c5 and a real number lambda.
An arbitrary local certificate hlocal of type LocalDef006 run c5 lambda.
hypotheses: Writing N for the model's operation count, the model packages a measure mu with mu(Omega)=1, functions exactValue, computedValue, and error indexed by Fin N, and a unit roundoff u0 with 0<=u0<1. It assumes computedValue_k=exactValue_k(1+error_k), |error_k|<=u0, measurability, integrability and zero mean of every error, and the stated integral-factorization property against integrable functions of earlier errors.

The run packages m>0 and r>0; a vector b in R^m; vectors v_j in R^m; perturbation matrices Delta_j(u,omega); computed vectors y(u,omega); and output indices. For j<r it assumes sum_i v_j(i)^2=2 and P_j^2=I. It also assumes y(u,omega)=T_r(u,omega)b for every real u and omega, and agreement with selected model computed values at u0.
The explicit scalar assumptions are c5>0 and lambda>0.

Writing E for hlocal.localEvent and rho_m(lambda,u)=exp(((lambda*sqrt(m))*u+m*u^2)/(1-u))-1, the certificate makes E measurable, gives mu(E)=1, and states omega in E iff every j<r satisfies ||Delta_j(u0,omega)x||_2<=c5*rho_m(lambda,u0)||x||_2 for all x. On E, every entry of Delta_j(u,omega) is O(u) as u tends to zero for every j<r.
conclusions: There exist two functions R_un and R_fac from Real x Omega to the m by m real matrices. They may depend on every preceding binder; under the nested existential quantifiers, R_fac may in particular be selected after R_un.
For every omega in E and every pair of matrix indices i,k, R_un(u,omega)_{ik}=O(u^2) and R_fac(u,omega)_{ik}=O(u^2) as u tends to zero.
For every real u and every omega, y(u,omega)=Q_r b+(A_r(u,omega)+R_un(u,omega))b.
For every real u and every omega, y(u,omega)=Q_r b+Q_r(S_r(u,omega)+R_fac(u,omega))b. In the literal Lean expression the leading Q_r is written as (Q_r^T)^T.
For every u, omega, and j in Fin r, LocalDef010(run,u,omega,j)=Q_{j+1}^T Delta_j(u,omega)Q_j; this repeats the definition of LocalDef010.
mathematical_definitions: For x in R^m, ||x||_2=sqrt(sum_i x_i^2); matrix-vector and matrix-matrix products are the ordinary finite real products.
Define Q_0=I and Q_{k+1}=P_kQ_k, so Q_k=P_{k-1}...P_0.
Define T_0=I and T_{k+1}(u,omega)=(P_k+Delta_k(u,omega))T_k(u,omega). The run hypothesis says y(u,omega)=T_r(u,omega)b.
Define the unfactored first-order accumulation A_0=0 and A_{k+1}(u,omega)=P_kA_k(u,omega)+Delta_k(u,omega)Q_k.
For j<r define F_j(u,omega)=Q_{j+1}^T Delta_j(u,omega)Q_j, and define S_r(u,omega)=sum_{j=0}^{r-1}F_j(u,omega).
For a matrix function R, the condition used here means separately for every entry that R_{ik}(u)=O(u^2) along the real neighborhood filter at zero.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurable outcome space, every encoded stochastic model and compatible positive-dimensional reflector-product run, every positive natural c5 and positive real lambda, and every associated probability-one local certificate, there are global unfactored and factored matrix remainder functions. On the certificate's local event, each entry of each remainder is second order in u near zero. For all real u and all outcomes, the computed vector is exactly the unperturbed product Q_r b plus either the unfactored first-order accumulation A_r and its remainder applied to b, or Q_r times the sum of transformed first-order perturbations and its factored remainder applied to b. The declaration additionally restates the defining formula for each transformed perturbation.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although m and r are syntactically arbitrary naturals, an inhabitant of the run type carries proofs m>0 and r>0.
The theorem is universal over model, run, and local-certificate inhabitants. It is vacuous for choices for which any required encoded structure, positivity proof, or local certificate does not exist.
The remainder functions are defined for all u and omega, and both algebraic identities hold for all u and omega, but the O(u^2) conclusions hold only for omega in E.
The event E has model measure exactly one, but no remainder bound is asserted outside E.

The Big-O property is entrywise and pointwise in omega. Its constants and neighborhoods may depend on omega and on the pair of matrix indices; no uniform matrix-norm or outcome-uniform estimate is encoded.
The Big-O limit is the two-sided real neighborhood filter at u=0. It does not directly provide a stated numerical bound at the fixed unit roundoff u0.
No measurability, integrability, or continuity of either existential remainder as a function of omega or u is required.
The two remainders are not asserted to be unique, and no explicit formula or direct relation between them is part of the target beyond their respective exact identities.
The second witness is under the first existential and may constructively depend on the first witness, although classically the conclusion is simply simultaneous existence of the pair.
The constants c5 and lambda affect the encoded local event and its perturbation bound, but they do not occur explicitly in either decomposition formula or second-order scale.
The local operator bound is imposed only on Delta_j at the model's unit roundoff; the near-zero assumption on Delta_j is instead entrywise O(u).

The model's bounded, mean-zero, measurable, integrable, and prior-error factorization assumptions are encoded in the model type, but the conclusion itself states no expectation, tail probability, or output-error bound.
The last matrix equality is exactly the definition of LocalDef010 and therefore imposes no additional mathematical restriction.

All identities are in exact real finite-dimensional matrix arithmetic; the proposition does not itself formalize machine arithmetic operations or rounding execution semantics beyond the data encoded in the model and run types.
